records.subject: Confirming cancellation for River Partners
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Confirming the cancellation on our end. We're sorry Wrenfield didn't end up being the right fit for River Partners -- the door's open if that changes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Maya,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, River Partners
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero customer replies to two outreach emails (email:e86a80cc, email:9fd864f7). No-showed the getting started call (calendar:919e11a9). Silent, unengaged Starter accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days; no tickets signal any active usage either.

draft.subject: Getting started with your first project
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

We missed you on the getting started call last week — no problem at all, I know launch weeks get full.

When you're ready, the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for is a first project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and inviting your team from Account Settings -> Members comes next.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Nadia
